rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something belonging to her when the owned noun is omitted.

example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 keoi5 ge3

rows.note: Use this specifically when “hers” means her home or place, especially after verbs such as 去.

example.english: We’ll go to hers after dinner.
example.traditional: 我哋食完飯就去佢屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sik6 jyun4 faan6 zau6 heoi3 keoi5 uk1 kei2
